commits.message: Fix and refactor authentication, MFA, and token flows

feat: Major Sales Portal, Group Booking, and Service Portal improvements

🎯 Customer Schema & Validation Updates:
- Made firstName/lastName conditionally required (only for INDIVIDUAL customers)
- Added representativeName field for company customer contacts
- Made companyName required for COMPANY type customers
- Made dateOfBirth conditionally required (only for INDIVIDUAL customers)
- Added createdFrom field tracking (WEBSITE/DASHBOARD/GROUP_BOOKING/PHONE_ORDER/IMPORT)
- Made userId conditionally required for website-created customers

💳 Payment Flow & Stripe Integration:
- Added POST /v1/orders/:orderId/payment-intent endpoint
- Added POST /v1/orders/:orderId/confirm-payment endpoint
- Fixed payment intent creation to validate zero/negative amounts
- Prevented advancing to payment step when order amount is £0
- Enhanced getOrderAmount() to check itemsTotal, grandTotalToPay, totalAmount
- Improved Stripe backend with best practices:
  * Pinned API version to 2023-10-16
  * Added automatic network retries (maxNetworkRetries: 2)
  * Enabled automatic_payment_methods for better conversion
  * Added idempotency keys for safe payment retries
  * Added statement_descriptor_suffix for clear bank statements
  * Added receipt_email for automatic customer receipts
  * Added minimum amount validation (£0.30)

🛒 Sales Portal (QuickOrderPanel) Improvements:
- Fixed company customer creation validation errors
- Added representative name field in company customer form
- Moved dateOfBirth field inside customerType conditional rendering
- Improved order summary display with proper Order ID extraction
- Fixed order amount display to check multiple field variants
- Renamed step label from 'Service Details' to 'Order Details'
- Enhanced error handling with user-friendly messages
- Fixed payment flow to prevent false success confirmations

📦 Group Booking Enhancements:
- Fixed Group Booking button navigation to /groupbooking page
- Updated to use new payment-intent and confirm-payment endpoints
- Improved service selection with search and category filters
- Enhanced Review Order UI with summary cards

🔧 Service Portal Improvements:
- Added payment status filter (only shows paymentStatus === 2 - paid orders)
- Fixed cardDetails/testDetails rendering error in service details dialog
- Changed from rendering objects directly to using JSON.stringify()
- Removed 'Support Tickets' tab (now in dedicated sidebar navigation)
- Removed unused TicketManagement import and SupportIcon
- Updated tab configuration to only show 3 tabs

📊 Data Normalization Enhancements:
- Updated getOrderAmount() in dataNormalizationClient.js to check:
  * order.amount, order.grandTotalToPay, order.itemsTotal
  * order.total, order.grandTotal, order.totalAmount, order.orderTotal
- Updated propertyAccessUtils.js with same improvements
- Improved order object normalization for consistent data display

🐛 Bug Fixes:
- Fixed recipientId ObjectId casting errors in group bookings
- Fixed missing customerId for group booking orders
- Fixed Customer schema validation for company customers
- Fixed order items missing required fields (title, serviceType)
- Fixed payment success showing even when payment failed
- Fixed service details dialog runtime errors (objects as React children)
- Fixed MenuMobile and MenuDesktop Group Booking navigation

✅ Issues Resolved:
#1: Company customer creation validation - FIXED
#2: Order Details section positioning - IMPROVED
#3: Order ID and Amount display - FIXED
#4: Payment intent zero amount handling - FIXED
#5: False payment success prevention - FIXED
#6: Service Portal unpaid orders filter - FIXED
#7: cardDetails/testDetails rendering error - FIXED
#8: Support Tickets tab removal - FIXED
#9: Ticket feature documentation - DOCUMENTED
#10: All fixes tested and verified - COMPLETED
